messages:
eli: FYI urgent hotfix for embeddings-service (v2.4.0 -> v2.4.1). Small memory leak under high load in eu-central causing pod restarts. No schema or DB changes. Target change window 02:30-04:00 UTC. Need expedited approvals and a clear rollback/pin.

deploybot: CI status: passing. Staging canaries green. Rollout plan: canary 3% -> 25% -> 80% -> 100% with 3m observation per step. Manual approval required for fasttrack. Logs: https://ci.internal/embeds/1810007777

ops-oncall: I'm available. +1 if rollback can be immediate and we have a traffic pin fallback. Recommend starting on eu-central only.

eli: Kill-switch is `/deploy rollback embeddings-service --to 2.4.0 --immediate`. Also documented in ops-runbook: https://runbook/internal/embeds/rollback. If deploybot can't revert, we have a traffic pin in the load-balancer.

ronnie: Release note suggestion: "embeddings-service v2.4.1: fixes transient memory leak under burst; no client action required." I can post to console.

izzy: Product +1 for expedited. Please note in console that edge regions are staggered.

sam: Monitoring thresholds: fail if pod_restarts > 1 per min OR 5xx_rate +1.0% absolute OR p95 latency +200ms. If any breach, abort and rollback.

deploybot: Manual approval requested. Run `/deploy approve 1810007777 --fasttrack --by eli` to proceed.

eli: `/deploy approve 1810007777 --fasttrack`

deploybot: Approval received from eli. Starting canary (3%) in eu-central. Observing 6m for memory RSS and restart counts.

deploybot: Canary step (3%) complete: memory stable, 0 restarts, p95 +12ms. Advancing to 25%.

ops-oncall: Seeing slight increase in CPU but within expected. Proceed.

deploybot: Advanced to 25%. Monitoring 3m. Metrics: pod_restarts 0, 5xx_rate 0.02%, p95 +40ms.

eli: Hold 02— pause . I see an unrelated deploy in eu-central A/B testing that might be causing noise. pausing until ops confirms.

ops-oncall: Confirmed noisy experiment on edge-proxy. I'm pausing the rollout and pinning traffic back to 2.4.0 for safety. Executing pin now.

deploybot: Executing rollback to 2.4.0 for canary groups. Commands: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeddings-service embeddings=embeds:2.4.0` then re-apply traffic pin.

deploybot: Rollback finished; services stable and pods healthy. Traffic pinned to 2.4.0.

izzy: Good catch. I'll mark release as "deferred" in the console and update product notes.

ronnie: Posting draft release note to console as deferred and include rollback details: "Attempted v2.4.1 canary but paused due to unrelated edge experiment; rolled back to v2.4.0. Investigation ongoing."

sam: I'll open a short ops checklist: pre-flight (mute experiments), increase canary observation to 10m next run, gating on memory RSS and restart counts.

eli: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the experiment is disabled. Re-open ticket if you see any post-rollback regressions. :thumbsup:
